messages:
marta-acme: Hi team — invoice INV-2026-042 is blocked in billing. The customer uploaded a resale certificate but it still shows as 'on hold' with reverse-charge flag. They need the invoice released for PO 5542 by EOD CET.
omar-support: Checking the billing UI now. I see a hold reason: 'VAT_ID_INACTIVE (VIES)'. Customer says the uploaded file was a signed resale_cert_5542.pdf. :thinking:
lisa-billing: Can you paste the webhook payload or the billing log for the upload? Sometimes the parser fails if filename encoding is weird.
omar-support: Paste from the webhook log:
```
{ "event": "resale_cert_uploaded", "invoice": "INV-2026-042", "file": "resale_cert_5542.pdf", "country": "NL", "vat_id": "NL123456789B01", "vies_check": { "status": 200, "result": "inactive", "raw": "VIES response: inactive" } }
```
omar-support: Webhook delivered 200 to billing-service but validation returned inactive. Customer insists their VAT ID is active.
felix-eng: VIES flakiness is a thing. Can you run the internal validation endpoint with the same payload? Use this command:
```
curl -X POST https://billing.internal/validate-vat \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"country":"NL","vat_id":"NL123456789B01","trace_id":"trace-2198"}'
```
felix-eng: Expected response normally is {"valid":true}. If VIES returns inactive we log and set hold. I'll check retry/backoff code.
omar-support: Ran it — response below:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "valid": false, "reason": "vies_inactive", "vies_response": "inactive", "trace_id": "trace-2198" }
```
lisa-billing: Customer attached a PDF but their PO number on the invoice is 5542 while account metadata has PO 5542-US. Our PO normalization dropped the suffix leading to mismatch; system flags it as PO_MISMATCH and combined with vies_inactive leads to auto-hold.
marta-acme: Oh — the customer says they used the parent PO and didn't include regional suffix. Can we map 5542 -> 5542-US? They provided a company letter confirming affiliation.
sara-legal: We can accept an affiliation letter as supporting evidence if it contains legal entity names and registration numbers. Need to redact personal info before storing. For automated bypass we require matched VAT or explicit manual override by billing ops.
lisa-billing: Proposed remediation steps:
1) Manually verify the resale cert PDF contents and upload metadata (company name, VAT ID, reg no.).
2) Add a PO alias mapping (5542 -> 5542-US) in billing account settings.
3) Retry VAT validation with a VIES recheck. If VIES still reports inactive, allow manual approve with note: "legal evidence accepted".
felix-eng: I'll push a quick log improvement to capture VIES request/response headers (non-sensitive). If we see intermittent 200+inactive, we can add a second lookup to the EU mirror.
lisa-billing: I've created support case SB-71290 and tagged for manual approve. billing-bot: new_case SB-71290 created (priority: high) :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: linked invoices: INV-2026-042 -> SB-71290
omar-support: Marta — can you ask the customer to resend the resale_cert as PDF/A (sometimes OCR pipeline truncates fonts) and attach the company registration extract? That'll speed legal sign-off.
marta-acme: Sent to customer asking for PDF/A and the company extract. Also requested explicit statement that invoice should be billed under PO 5542-US. They replied: "we confirm affiliation and provide registration extract, attaching signed_letter.pdf".
omar-support: I uploaded signed_letter.pdf to case SB-71290 and manually added PO alias 5542 -> 5542-US. Requested manual approve from billing ops.
lisa-billing: Manual approve performed on SB-71290. Note added: "legal evidence verified, VAT ID treated as provisional valid pending VIES replicate check." Invoice released. :tada:
felix-eng: Follow-up action: I'll add a fallback to call secondary VIES mirror and a 5-min retry window for 'inactive' responses. Filing an ops task: INF-1604.
sara-legal: Reminder: keep the uploaded documents in secure retention and redact phone/email if present before long-term storage.
marta-acme: Thanks everyone — customer confirmed payment processed and PO applied. Closing from our side.
omar-support: Closing thread; adding postmortem note to SB-71290 explaining root cause: PO alias missing + intermittent VIES inactive. Will add KB article on required file formats & PO aliasing. :memo:
